cases.question: Which five customers generated the most order revenue?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Show monthly order counts for this year.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_id), COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_id) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_id)

cases.question: What is the average order value by region?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT o.region, AVG(p.product_id) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.region

cases.question: Which products have the highest total quantity sold?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC

cases.question: How many orders are in each status?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status

cases.question: Find customers by city and country.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, a.city, a.country FROM customers c JOIN addresses a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.city IS NOT NULL AND a.country IS NOT NULL

cases.question: Which categories have the most products?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.category_id, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY product_count DESC

cases.question: Show revenue by product category.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.category_id, SUM(p.product_id * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id

cases.question: What inventory quantities are available by region?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT i.warehouse_region, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY i.warehouse_region

cases.question: Show payments collected by month and payment method.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, p.method, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payments FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY month, p.method ORDER BY month, p.method

cases.question: Compare order counts across customer regions and statuses.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT a.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM addresses a JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY a.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC

cases.question: What is the total value of products currently in inventory?
cases.logical_sql: SELECT SUM(p.product_id) FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id

cases.question: Show the top customers by number of orders this quarter.
cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(quarter FROM CURRENT_DATE) = EXTRACT(quarter FROM o.order_date::date) GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 10
